Capture lossless renderer PNGs at explicit native 1x/2x/3x pixels, independently encode WebP and AVIF, and record source/pipeline/output hashes and renderer evidence.
Add exact RGB-channel pixel tests and bounded 3-day visual evidence to the existing UX review workflow; no existing budget threshold was changed.
